closest_runtime_systems.bounded_description: A rule language expresses triggers, predicates and runtime enforcement for agents. Its reported domains include code execution.
Symbolic policies constrain tool names and arguments. The current abstract describes SMT classification of policy updates, with automatic narrowing and approval for expansion.
A layer separates control and data flow from trusted queries and uses capabilities to constrain data flow at tool calls.

workshop_cfp.relevant_topic: Verification of and for AI: formal validation of generated outputs, runtime monitoring of agents, verified guardrails, and constrained tool use.
